normal.name: SpookyNess (Nesstalgic) 🪾🐦‍⬛ Cozy Games & Reviews
normal.text: Today was a busy one but I managed to squeeze in four demos from Steam Next Fest for thirty minutes eCh! Check them out along with a quick first impression of what I liked at the end of each game! Which ones were your favorite?
normal.media: link card: Playing Four Demos From Steam Next Fest

normal.name: Starlight
normal.text: You totally should open a Retro gaming clothing line for girls, I'd buy them! Love the dress! Super Mario Bros 3 is one of my favorite 2D Mario games, only surpassed by Doki Doki Panic (I know it's not an actual Mario game, but you know what? I don't care. XD)

normal.name: Sasha's Retrobytes 🏳️‍⚧️
normal.text: *go away ;w; There's some really nice presentation flair for their first game, with pre-rendered mission hubs and some pretty solid texture mapping and polygonal graphics. And an immersive rendered cockpit. I remember picking this up cheap while catching up on DOS games with my first Win 95 PC.
normal.media: 2 images: A briefing chamber with a holographic pillar in the middle and Babylon 5-like airlock doors. / A snap of the first-person gameplay with a pre-rendered mech cockpit and a gun turret tower in front opening fire.
